newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague bourse closes down, but analysts optimistic.
newsitem.headline: Prague bourse closes down, but analysts optimistic.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange backed off Friday's year-high in heavier acticity on Monday, as a round of profit-taking pushed the PX50 index down 4.6 points, or 0.77 percent, to 595.1.

SPT Telecom, Komercni Banka, CEZ, Chemopetrol and Skoda all lost ground, but dealers said they had expected the fall as investors took profits, but the bourse is still seen firming over the short-term.
Overall, 266 issues gained ground, while 235 lost and 117 were unchanged. Total volume was heavier at 1.78 million shares on turnover of 1.92 billion crowns.
"The market has corrected a little bit, but there seems to be good support at this level," Marco Anderegg of Patria Finance told Reuters.
"Foreign investor interest remains solid and towards the end of last week broader issues were gaining interest so it looks solid for a lot of the market," he added.
